drafts.zu: Izitayela ze-Oblique zihlala zibonakala uma usuka ebalazweni elinezilinganiso eziqondile.
drafts.st: Ditaele tsa Oblique di dula di bonahala ha o tloha mmapeng o lekantsweng hantle.
drafts.ts: Switayele swa Oblique swi sala swi vonaka loko u suka eka mepe lowu pimiweke hi ku kongoma.
drafts.ve: Zwitaila zwa Oblique zwi dzula zwi tshi vhonala musi ni tshi bva kha mapa wo elwaho nga vhukuma.
